items.title: Combinatorial formula and sequence-independent symmetrization for nested Bethe vectors in evaluation Yangian gl4 modules
items.author: Maksim Kosmakov; Vitaly Tarasov
items.source_version: Current publisher corrected version July26,2026; SIGMA21(2025),060; native TeX from current rather than previous-version download
items.difficulty_reason: Derives an explicit off-shell nested Bethe-vector formula by noncommutative Yangian splitting, combinatorial partitioning and rational symmetrization identities, including the full supporting appendix. main and main2 are two formulations of one target; their sequence-independence assertion and symmetry proof remain in the same counted problem.

primary.label: Complete first author formulation main, same counted target
Complete closed-form main2 including sequence-independent symmetrization

proof_spans.label: Full splitting construction and source-local preparatory proof for the principal formula
Author main-formula proof and preparation for closed form
Complete closed-form proof and all remaining Sections4-7/AppendixA continuation and supporting symmetrization/splitting proofs

contexts.label: Complete author introduction, Yangian/evaluation and weight-function definitions
